story_text:
Lighter. Faster. Steadier. More versatile.
The world’s first one-click travel tripod is here. Ready in just 3 seconds.
Built on COMAN in-house developed one-click mechanism, we’ve achieved another breakthrough: this is the world’s first travel tripod packing this sophisticated one-click mechanism into a slim 26mm leg tube.
That means no more frantic fumbling when you need to set up fast. Ready in just 3 seconds, anywhere, anytime — calm and effortless.
The lightning deployment, portability, rock-solid stability and modular expandability of the T1 MINI all stem from the core vision of the COMAN GO! Bringing time-saving convenience to every creator.
M1, T1, T2 and T1 MINI share the same foundational technology. The unified platform caters to diverse user needs with proven reliability and consistent stability.
The T1 MINI is our pinnacle design balancing speed, portability and stability.
Few even imagined it, and even fewer could pull it off: a one-click tripod that fits inside a 20-inch carry-on suitcase. But the T1MINI makes it happen, with effortless ease.
Twenty-two years ago, the world’s first compact carbon fiber travel tripod was released. Today, the market is flooded with travel tripods, yet most still rely on flip locks or twist locks for leg adjustment.
Flip locks give clear locking feedback but are tedious to operate; twist locks feel smoother, yet it’s hard to tell instantly whether they are securely tightened. Both methods typically take 10–15 seconds or longer to set up, with a risk of pinching your fingers.
Today, the COMAN T1 MINI — the world’s first one-click travel tripod — disrupts this long-standing industry norm.
The all-new T1 MINI goes even further: lighter, more compact, with freely adjustable height for seamless adaptation to every shooting scenario.
You’ve definitely felt the pain point of traditional twist-knob camera locks: it’s hard to gauge tightening force, and twisting them in freezing cold is a real hassle.
Now, COMAN brand-new Arca quick-release system lets you mount or remove your camera in just one second — clean and effortless.
For traditional tripods, leveling is a time-consuming and laborious process. You need to check whether your camera is level while adjusting the extension length of the last leg section for stability. (When you don’t fully extend the legs, less extension of the last section delivers better stability.) Usually, you have to repeat this process at least twice to make sure the tripod fits the terrain and the camera stays level.
With the T1MINI, you only need to adjust the leg extension via the one-touch . You can achieve precise leveling in basically one try, no repeated bending over required. Thanks to gravity, the tripod will automatically deploy the first three leg sections first, so stability is never a concern.
Our T1 launched earlier this year and won wide acclaim. Meanwhile, we received honest feedback: existing one-click tripods, including the T1, tend to be heavy. Creators wanted a lightweight, highly portable one-click tripod they could take anywhere.
We have spent 4 years preparing for this, with 5 rounds of prototype revisions. Now, the world’s lightest one-click tripod has arrived.
This groundbreaking one-click design builds on our four-generation shared technology. COMAN pushes its one-click system to new heights by packing this intricate precision mechanism into a 26mm travel tripod — an achievement unmatched by any other product on the market.
Its specially shaped carbon fiber triangular center column keeps the whole rig compact, lightweight enough for effortless single-hand gripping.
The leg tubes are woven from 10-layer 3K carbon fiber for rock-solid stability. Special-edition Silver and Army Green finishes are also available.
Whether you’re shooting amid jungles and snow-capped mountains or capturing urban street scenes, it makes you stand out — an eye-catching companion wherever you go.
At only 1.6 kg, it safely supports camera rigs up to 6 kg. Its leg lock system can hold up to 20 kg without slipping once secured.
The quick-release base is compatible with over 90% of Arca-style plates on the market. It also features an extra dual anti-drop safety mechanism to keep your camera secure.
It supports 360° horizontal panorama shooting, one-tap 90° portrait mode, 360° spherical adjustment, and multi-angle leg positioning — ready for all terrains and complex shooting conditions.
We’ve developed three brand-new accessories exclusively for the T1MINI, bringing it modular design and expanded versatility. One tripod, fully capable, ready to handle all kinds of shooting scenarios.
risks: The COMAN T1 MINI tripod faces several potential risks and challenges, including possible delays in manufacturing and fulfillment. As a lightweight carbon fiber tripod featuring a rapid deployment mechanism, maintaining consistent quality, structural stability, and reliable performance requires rigorous testing and quality control throughout production. Supply chain disruptions involving carbon fiber, precision-machined metal components, or other key materials could also affect production schedules and costs. In particular, the special finishing processes used for selected color editions require additional manufacturing steps and stricter quality standards, which may increase production complexity. Another challenge is ensuring that the T1 MINI delivers the right balance of portability, stability, durability, and ease of use across different shooting environments. We will continue refining production processes, conducting quality inspections, and providing clear user guidance to ensure a reliable experience. Finally, unexpected changes in logistics, material costs, or global economic conditions may affect timelines or expenses. We will work closely with our manufacturing and supply chain partners, communicate progress transparently, and do our best to deliver COMAN T1 MINI to our backers as planned.

faq.q: What is the COMAN GO! T1 MINI?
faq.a: The COMAN GO! T1 MINI is a compact carbon-fiber travel tripod built for creators who want fast one-touch deployment, professional stability, and flexible shooting options without the bulk of a traditional tripod.

faq.q: Who is the T1 MINI designed for?
faq.a: It is designed for travel photographers, filmmakers, vloggers, mobile creators, and hybrid shooters who need a lightweight tripod that can move quickly between locations and shooting styles.

faq.q: How quickly can the T1 MINI be deployed?
faq.a: Its patented one-touch mechanism lets you unlock, extend, and secure the tripod in about 3 seconds, so you can react quickly when a shot appears.

faq.q: What makes the one-touch system different from a conventional travel tripod?
faq.a: Instead of adjusting multiple leg locks one by one, the T1 MINI integrates the release mechanism into its compact leg structure, making setup faster and reducing repetitive adjustments.

faq.q: How much does the T1 MINI weigh?
faq.a: The T1 MINI weighs approximately 1.6 kg, making it light enough for travel while retaining the stability required for serious camera setups.

faq.q: What is the folded length of the T1MINI, and can one of the legs be detached and used as a monopod?
faq.a: The T1 MINI measures 533 mm (21 in) when folded. Its legs are not detachable, so they cannot be removed and used as a monopod.
The tripod supports a maximum payload of up to 6 kg. Always keep the total weight of the camera, lens, head, phone mount, and accessories within this limit.

faq.q: What material is the tripod made from?
faq.a: The T1 MINI uses a 10-layer 3K carbon-fiber construction to balance low weight, rigidity, and dependable support.
The four leg sections measure 26 mm, 23 mm, 20 mm, and 17 mm in diameter.

faq.q: Why is the 26 mm maximum tube diameter important?
faq.a: COMAN’s patented one-touch structure is integrated inside a maximum tube diameter of only 26 mm, giving the tripod a compact profile that is easy to grip and carry with one hand.

faq.q: Can the T1 MINI be used on uneven terrain?
faq.a: Yes. Its independently adjustable leg angles help you level the tripod on rocky trails, stairs, slopes, grass, and uneven streets.

faq.q: How many leg-angle positions are available?
faq.a: The tripod provides three independent leg-angle positions, allowing each leg to be adjusted for the terrain and the composition.

faq.q: What quick-release system does the T1 MINI use?
faq.a: It uses a next-generation Arca-style quick-release system designed for fast mounting, secure locking, and efficient transitions between shots.

faq.q: How fast can I mount a camera?
faq.a: The quick-release system is designed for approximately 1-second mounting when used with a compatible plate and a correctly prepared camera setup.

faq.q: Does the quick-release system include anti-drop protection?
faq.a: Yes. A multi-stage anti-drop locking design helps prevent accidental release while keeping setup fast and intuitive.
